newsitem.title: MALTA: Rates unchanged in Malta bills issue.
newsitem.headline: Rates unchanged in Malta bills issue.

text.p: The Malta Treasury on Friday is to issue Lm6.3 million ($17.5 million) in 28-day treasury bills maturing on October 4, 1996.
The weighted average yield rate is 4.9961 percent per annum, resulting from a weighted average bid price of Lm99.6182, the same as the previous 28-day issue of August 23, 1996.

The treasury will also issue Lm6.7 million ($18.6 million) in 91-day treasury bills maturing on December 6 at a weighted average yield rate of 4.9974 percent per annum, equivalent to a weighted average bid price of Lm98.7694, also unchanged from the previous 91-day issue on August 30.
